name: Etherification (MTBE, ETBE, TAME)
principle: Reactive isobutylene (from FCC or steam cracker C4) or isoamylenes (from light FCC naphtha) are reacted with methanol or ethanol over an acid resin catalyst to make high-octane ethers. Axens combines expanded-bed reactors with Catacol reactive distillation. Isobutylene can be recovered again by back-cracking MTBE.

process_steps.name: C4 or C5 olefin cut plus alcohol

suppliers.name: Lummus Technology
suppliers.product: etherification technologies (CDEthers/CDTaee line - MTBE, ETBE, TAEE and bio-ethers)
suppliers.note: Lummus announced start-up of its CDTaee bio-ethers unit at Hellenic Petroleum's Aspropyrgos refinery, Greece, Aug 2020

performance.basis: Axens claim for MTBE/ETBE with Catacol

advantages: Octane and lower olefin content in gasoline
Axens: over 40 MTBE/ETBE and over 20 TAME/TAEE references
limitations: Local MTBE bans are not covered by the source

sources.note: Hydrocarbon Engineering, Lummus CDTaee start-up at Aspropyrgos, 18 Aug 2020
